whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The 2026–27 school year starts one day earlier, on August 24 instead of August 25.
Spring Break moves earlier, from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 22–26 in 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every GCS school follow the Traditional Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Most GCS schools use the Traditional Calendar, but extended-year schools and some early/middle college programs follow separate academic calendars. Confirm the calendar assigned to your student's school or program.

calendarFaqs.q: Which GCS teacher workdays are no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: Students do not attend on optional teacher workdays September 21, October 30, and January 4, or mandatory teacher workdays November 3, January 25, February 15, and April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Is January 4 part of GCS Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The official Winter Break ends January 1. Monday, January 4 is a separate optional teacher workday, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded GCS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import, not a live subscription. If GCS changes the calendar later, previously imported dates will not update automatically.

sourceReviewSummary: Last checked August 9, 2026, against the GCS Traditional Academic Calendar and official inclement-weather guidance.
sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the first and last days, holidays, break dates, four grading-period endings, and all seven optional or mandatory teacher workdays against the official GCS PDF.
Return dates use the next student attendance day after each published break and account for the separate January 4 optional teacher workday.

GCS's weather guidance says its 180-day, 1,080-hour calendar provides 14 days of flexibility: up to five remote-learning days plus nine days through reduced instructional hours before the Board would need to consider an adjustment.
The .ics file is a one-time import, not a live subscription. Previously imported dates do not update automatically.
